examples.title: Train a regressor with absolute error
examples.code:
import tempfile
import torch
from topologies import Trainer, build, synth
root = tempfile.mkdtemp()
@synth.generator
def samples(ctx):
 x = torch.randn(6, generator=ctx.rng.torch)
 return {"inputs": synth.Tensor(x), "targets": synth.Tensor(x[:2])}
ds = synth.Spec("mae", generator=samples, size=16, splits={"train": 0.75, "val": 0.25}, seed=11, root=root, monitor="none").run()
train = ds.for_recipe("regression", split="train", input_field="inputs", target_field="targets", preserve_shape=True)
val = ds.for_recipe("regression", split="val", like=train, input_field="inputs", target_field="targets", preserve_shape=True)
model = build("mlp", "tiny", in_features=6, out_features=2)
trainer = Trainer(model, train, val, recipe="regression", recipe_config={"loss": "mean-absolute-error"}, max_epochs=1, device="cpu")
trainer.fit()
result = trainer.evaluate(val)
